vlm.face_critique: Chibi proportions are captured generally, but the face appears flattened in profile and the cheerful expression is lost to a sullen mouth.
vlm.secondary_critique: The shoulder dragon lacks clean separation and merges into the silhouette, missing the smoke puff; the staff wheel is softened and blunt.
vlm.back_critique: The rear view is heavily underexposed in shadow, obscuring volume consistency and revealing somewhat blobby hair segmentation.
structural_flaws: Dragon companion fused into hair and shoulder mesh
Staff filigree collapsed into a solid disk
aesthetic_flaws: Muddied textures and loss of robe embroidery detail
Dull eye highlights compared to concept
